name: @nec/discovery
description: Public NEC Discovery orchestrator above @nec/core: explicit caller-supplied candidate contexts, exact candidate-id and presentation-only environment scope filters, fail-closed binding validation, and a deterministic Core-built/verified DiscoverNetworksResult. Classification is delegated to Core composeDiscoveryMatch. No network I/O, no ranking or scoring, no network choice, no wallet, signing, funding or submission.
